summary.en:
- Rin Tohsaka is a sub-DPS character with a unique Joint Follow-Up ATK with Archer.
- After Archer uses his Skill, if there are three or fewer Skill Points or if Archer has used his Skill five times successively, Rin Tohsaka and Archer will lauch a Joint Follow-Up ATK, dealing damage and recovering four Skill Points.
- Whenever allies gain or consume Skill Points, Rin Tohsaka gains "Gem Energy". If she has 15 or more "Gem Energy", or if the team has more than 7 Skill Points, she can use her Enhanced Skill. This Enhanced Skill deals increased damage based on her current "Gem Energy" and consumes all except two Skill Points. If there are fewer than two Skill Points, Rin will not consume any Skill Points.
- Rin Tohsaka is a core support for Archer, but can also be played as a Main DPS with Eidolons and her S1 [[light-cone:flickering-stars]].

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:flickering-stars]] grants Rin Tohsaka CRIT Rate, Skill DMG, and a teamwide DEF Ignore buff. It is her strongest vertical investment for overall team damage and provides a significant boost to Main DPS Rin.
- E2 increases Rin Tohsaka's personal Skill DMG while also increasing the Skill multiplier for all allies. This is a significant increase to both her own damage and Archer's damage.
- E1 allows her to utilize a new resource called "Shadow Gem" in addition to her normal "Gem Energy" and Skill Points. This makes her bursts of Skill DMG much more consistent, greatly increasing her personal DPS. However, when used primarily as an Archer support, Rin Tohsaka's personal damage is relatively low, making this Eidolon a modest upgrade to overall team damage.
